goals.title: Deploy stage exits 0

goals.title: Test gate passes before every deploy
goals.description: test_rc must be 0 or the pipeline hard-gates. Metric binding code-verified; no recorded runs yet.
directives: Treat a red test gate as a full stop - no build/push/deploy stages run

goals.title: Post-deploy smoke check passes
goals.description: smoke_ok is boolean (1=pass); a deploy that fails smoke must roll back or alert. Metric binding code-verified; no recorded runs yet.
directives: A failed smoke check after a successful deploy is an incident, not a warning
